chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān, from Mālik al-Juhanī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about what comes out of the nostril of a beast and then gets onto me. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A teknonym referring to Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is unobjectionable

ai.seo_question: Is what comes out of an animal’s nostril considered najasah if it touches a person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding moisture or discharge coming from the nostril of an animal that touches a person. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem with it, indicating its ritual purity in this context.
